Operate the Tailscale zero-trust mesh — ACLs, device posture, and access routing — alongside Information Security, who owns identity and the access policy itself. Production experience operating Tailscale or comparable zero-trust network access (ZTNA), and certificate / mTLS fundamentals. Office buildouts and structured / low-voltage cabling — commissioning networked building systems and coordinating installers. Physical-security and AV networking — getting cameras / access-control (e.g. Verkada) and conferencing (Neat, Zoom) onto the network and keeping them available. Comfortable running work through an ITSM / service-desk platform and adopting AI-assisted, agentic automation — we run an AI-native ITSM (Serval).
